about.heading: About Us
paragraphs: Al Jamia Arts and Science College stands as a center of academic excellence, innovation, and holistic development. Established in 2010, the institution is affiliated with the University of Calicut, recognized by the Government, and approved by AICTE. Accredited with a NAAC B++ Grade and certified under ISO 9001:2015, the college upholds high standards in teaching, learning, and institutional practices. Nestled within a serene 50-acre eco-friendly campus and honored with an 'A Grade' by the Haritha Keralam Mission, Al Jamia provides a nurturing and inclusive environment that promotes both intellectual growth and environmental consciousness.

The National Commission for Minority Educational Institutions, Government of India, has granted minority status to the institution. Strategically located near Perinthalmanna town along the Nilambur–highway Road, the college offers a serene and accessible setting. As a fully residential campus, Al Jamia provides well-maintained hostel facilities for both girls and boys, ensuring a safe, disciplined and value-based living environment.

vision: To provide value based education to enrich, enlighten and empower the young generation to become the leaders of the future.
mission: To emerge as an academic institution for modern arts and science education, setting a standard for the finest in the world.

programmes.heading: Academic Programmes & Fees
programmes.intro: From the academic year 2024–2025, the college has adopted the Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) introduced by the University of Calicut. Undergraduate programmes are structured for completion within three or four years; postgraduate programmes run two years. The semester tuition fee is the same for students admitted under both merit and management categories.

admission.heading: Admission Process
management_steps: Application submitted directly at the college office, and also through the link on the college website.
Admission granted only to candidates who secure the cut-off marks fixed by the management, subject to university and government norms.

Document verification: SSLC & Plus Two certificates, Transfer Certificate, Conduct Certificate, 2 copies of SSLC/Plus Two certificates, ID proof, 2 passport photos, University CAP Registration Printout.
Management application form must carry the signature of an authorized Management Committee member.
All prescribed admission and tuition fees remitted within the stipulated time.
merit_steps: Application through the university's centralized admission process/allotment system; college application via the website link is mandatory.
Admission granted only to candidates who satisfy eligibility conditions prescribed by the university and government.
University publishes the rank list and allotment based on merit and reservation norms.
Candidates who receive allotment must report to the college within the time mentioned in the allotment memo.
Document verification: SSLC & Plus Two certificates, Transfer Certificate, Conduct Certificate, Community/Income certificates (if applicable), Allotment memo, ID proof, passport photos.
All prescribed admission and tuition fees remitted within the stipulated time.
admission.note: Under both routes, admission is complete only after document verification, fee payment, and the Principal's signature/approval — followed by university registration or confirmation. Classes commence strictly as per the schedule issued by the university.
